stories.title: External Link Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define the response schema for external provider research links including fields: source_type (Healthgrades, NPI, state_board), url, validation_status, and guidance_text. Establish a strict contract for downstream facade and chat consumers.

stories.title: Core Link Generation Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic logic to construct external research URLs for Healthgrades, NPI Registry, and supported state medical boards using provider identifiers (NPI, state). Include guidance text per source and explicit handling for unsupported or missing state mappings.

stories.title: URL Validation and Safety Integration
stories.description: Integrate URL Guardian to validate generated links using 3-stage validation (HEAD request, AI verification, Google correction fallback). Only validated, safe, and reachable URLs may be returned.

stories.title: Facade/API Exposure for External Links
stories.description: Expose validated external research links through evaluate_care_facade as part of the provider detail response contract, ensuring compatibility with chat output rendering.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Link Generation
stories.description: Create tests covering URL construction accuracy, validation outcomes, unsupported state fallback behavior, guidance text correctness, and end-to-end integration through evaluate_care_facade.
